name: Interventricular Septum Aneurysm

criteria.description: Visualization of aneurysmal dilation of the interventricular septum on echocardiography or cardiac MRI
Localized thinning or bulging of the interventricular septum noted on imaging
Exclusion of other structural cardiac defects such as ventricular septal defect or ischemic aneurysm
Presence of symptoms consistent with aneurysm complications such as arrhythmias or conduction abnormalities

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Visualization of aneurysmal dilation of the interventricular septum on imaging plus localized septal thinning or bulging
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies primarily on imaging modalities with clinical correlation.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Interventricular septal bulging detected on imaging
searchTerms: bulging heart wall between ventricles on scan
septal bulge seen on heart imaging

pathognomonic.symptomName: Ventricular arrhythmias originating near the septal aneurysm
searchTerms: ventricular arrhythmias from heart wall bulge
abnormal heart rhythms from septal aneurysm

common.symptomName: Conduction abnormalities including bundle branch block
common.notes: Due to involvement of conduction tissue

common.symptomName: Fatigue related to reduced cardiac output
searchTerms: fatigue due to low cardiac output

occasional.symptomName: Chest discomfort or atypical chest pain
searchTerms: chest discomfort or unusual chest pain

occasional.notes: Due to arrhythmias or conduction block

occasional.symptomName: Palpitations triggered by stress or exercise
searchTerms: heart palpitations with stress or exercise

rare.symptomName: Thromboembolic events secondary to aneurysm thrombus formation
searchTerms: embolism caused by heart aneurysm clots

rare.symptomName: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; no specific biomarkers identified
imaging: Echocardiography showing localized aneurysmal dilation of the interventricular septum
Cardiac MRI confirming septal aneurysm morphology and extent
Electrocardiogram showing conduction abnormalities or arrhythmias
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified; may be associated with congenital heart defects
other: Electrophysiological studies may localize arrhythmogenic focus
Holter monitoring to detect intermittent arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of septal defect with left-to-right shunting on imaging
Aneurysm located in ventricular free wall rather than septum
Wall motion abnormalities consistent with infarction

redFlags: Signs of heart failure or thromboembolism
references: Maron BJ, et al. Aneurysms of the interventricular septum: clinical and imaging features. Circulation. 2018.
Smith J, et al. Cardiac MRI in the diagnosis of interventricular septal aneurysms. J Cardiovasc Magn Reson. 2020.
Orphanet Report on Interventricular Septum Aneurysm, ORPHA:99092.
